Welcome, pom! "[C6FEFB]HATSUNE MIKU Collab Event[ffffff]" has\na new difficulty level, pom! The prizes have\nchanged too, pom! Check them out, pom!
Welcome, pom!\nIt's for playing high difficulty level here, pom!
Come back again after clearing the game\nfrom my friend over there, pom! Sorry, pom!
Pom, pommm! Isn't it a great concert stage, pom?\nThe Potums from all over the country helped to\nmake it, pom!
Pom?! So you're the adventurer that will repel\nthe Goblins? Let me hear your request if you\nhave any, pom!
I wanna see a different pose!
I wanna watch the event scene!
Pom, pommm!\nLet's try asking MIKU nicely, pom!\nHmm! And mind your manners when taking pictures!
Pom, pommm?! No way, pom! I hire them with\nexpensive apples, pom! Even if you're an excellent\ntamer, you just can't, pom!
Pom...pommm...Don't tell anyone, okay, pom?\nBut as the Potums will make the choice, it all\ndepends on you, pom!
Pom, pommm! Have you had enough fun, pom?\nI'll send you back if that's what you want, pom!
Yo! So you're also here for HATSUNE MIKU's\nconcert?
...What? So you come to this place despite not\nknowing what's going on here...?
Us? We happened to come across HATSUNE MIKU's\nconcert quite some time ago.
It was our first time listening to her song, and\nhow should I put it, the lyrics and the melody\njust hit and resonated with us...
That's why when HATSUNE MIKU's concert is held, we\nalways try to go and see it!
He drank like a fish before coming here, so
he is not allowed into the venue as he's\nintoxicated. That's so stupid of him...
He must be feeling upset and annoyed out there\nright now...Oh, it's about to begin!\nLook, that's HATSUNE MIKU!!
Gob, gob, gob! So the rumors are true, it's a good\nconcert venue, gob! We didn't come all the way\nhere for nothing, gob!
From now on, this place will be our concert venue,\ngob! Y'all just listen to my songs and enjoy my\ngolden voice, gob!!
Gob?! What do you want, gob?\nIf you want my autograph, later, gob!
Someone once said you need to break the mold to\ndiscover new music...
But, it seems like we've got a blockhead here who\nthinks that breaking the mold and breaking the law\nare the same thing!
You seem to not know the saying "Where there's\nmusic there can be no evil", do you?
It's a good chance to teach you properly about\nit!!
Don't get too cheeky, gob!\nJust keep your mouth shut and listen to my\nsinging, gob!!
You can now start the Event Battle through the\nConcert Potum in the venue.
Protect HATSUNE MIKU's concert stage by repelling\nthe approaching Goblins and their friends!!
This is so annoying, gob. I wanted to feel how it\nis like to receive a mass round of applause in\nsuch a big venue...But,
I won't succumb, gob!\nI won't disappear from the limelight just because\nof something like this, gob!
I won't disappear and I'll continue to live\nthrough hardship until I burn myself out, gob!!
Thanks a lot for protecting the stage.\nMay each day of your life be filled with wonderful\nmusic...
D-don't mention it, anyone would have done the\nsame!
We'll go to your concerts in the future too.\nIf weird creatures appear again, we'll repel them\nfor you!!
You can now exchange your MAGICAL Points for a\nprize!!
A new difficulty level (Lv100+) has been added!!
